## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

```{r}
setwd("~/Documents/R Projects/ecob2000_lab3_ishika_nawar")
load("d_HHP2020_241.Rdata")
attach(d_HHP2020_24)
d_HHP2020_24
```

```{r}
summary(d_HHP2020_24)
```

```{r}
table(Region, Mar_Stat)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(socviz)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}

divorced_data <- d_HHP2020_24 %>%
  filter(Mar_Stat == "divorced") %>%
  filter(!Education %in% c("lt hs", "some hs")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Education))

summary_data <- divorced_data %>%
  group_by(Region, Education) %>%
  summarize(freq = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(proportion = freq / sum(freq)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(Education))
```

```{r}
print(summary_data)
```

```{r}
summary_data$Education <- factor(summary_data$Education, levels = c("high school", "some college", "assoc deg", "college grad", "adv degree"))
summary_data$Region <- factor(summary_data$Region, levels = c("South", "West", "Northeast", "Midwest"))

```

```{r}
div_mainbar <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = Region, y = proportion, fill = Education)) + geom_col(position = "dodge") + labs(
  title = "Divorce Rate by Education Level and Region",
  x = "Region",
  y = "Divorce Rate",
  fill = "Education Level")

div_mainbar + theme_minimal() + scale_fill_discrete(name = "Education Level", labels = c("high school" = "High School", "some college" = "Some College", "assoc deg" = "Associate's Degree", "college grad" = "College Graduate", "adv degree" = "Advanced Degree"), palette = "Blues") + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```

```{r}
edu_labels <- c(
  "high school" = "High School",
  "some college" = "Some College",
  "assoc deg" = "Associate's Degree",
  "college grad" = "College Graduate",
  "adv degree" = "Advanced Degree"
)

divorced_data2 <- d_HHP2020_24 %>%
  filter(Mar_Stat == "divorced") %>%
  filter(!Education %in% c("lt hs", "some hs")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Education))

summary_data2 <- divorced_data2 %>%
  group_by(Education, Region) %>%
  summarize(freq = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Education) %>%
  mutate(proportion = freq / sum(freq)) %>%
  ungroup()

education_groupbar <- ggplot(summary_data2, aes(x = Region, y = proportion, fill = Region))
education_groupbar + geom_col() + facet_wrap(~ Education, nrow = 3, labeller = labeller(Education = edu_labels)) + 
  labs(
    title = "Divorce Rate by Region, by Education Level",
    x = "Region",
    y = "Divorce Rate",
    fill = "Region"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() + scale_fill_discrete(palette = "Purples") + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

```

```{r}
divorced_only <- d_HHP2020_24 %>%
  filter(Mar_Stat == "divorced")

region_summary <- divorced_only %>%
  group_by(Region) %>%
  summarize(freq = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(proportion = freq / sum(freq))

print(region_summary)
```

```{r}
ggplot(region_summary, aes(x = "", y = proportion, fill = Region)) +
  geom_col(width = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(proportion, accuracy = 0.1)),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5)) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Divorced Individuals Across Regions",
    fill = "Region"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Oranges")
```

```{r}
education_summary <- d_HHP2020_24 %>%
  filter(Mar_Stat == "divorced") %>%
  filter(!Education %in% c("lt hs", "some hs")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Education)) %>%
  group_by(Education) %>%
  summarize(freq = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(proportion = freq / sum(freq))

print(education_summary)
```

```{r}
edu_labels <- c(
  "high school" = "High School",
  "some college" = "Some College",
  "assoc deg" = "Associate's Degree",
  "college grad" = "College Graduate",
  "adv degree" = "Advanced Degree"
)

ggplot(education_summary, aes(x = "", y = proportion, fill = Education)) +
  geom_col(width = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(proportion, accuracy = 0.1)),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5)) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Divorced Individuals Across Education Levels",
    fill = "Education Level"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Greens", labels = edu_labels)
```
